stories.title: Roane County planners recommend denying heavy industrial rezoning after residents raise concerns
stories.summary: Roane County planners recommended denying a request to rezone 120 acres near Buttermilk Road for heavy industry after residents raised concerns.

stories.title: Sevierville police officers reflect on responding to the deadly Gatlinburg wildfires, 10 years later
stories.summary: Sevierville Police Lt. Caleb Brien and Deputy Chief Sam Hinson recalled door-knocking the night of Nov. 28, 2016, evacuating people from parts of Sevier County.

stories.title: Knoxville police to deploy drones for emergency response starting Nov. 19
stories.summary: The Knoxville Police Department said the drones were planned to take to the skies in September, but are now set to be deployed two months later.

stories.title: THP: Wanted woman from Georgia arrested in Knoxville
stories.summary: The Tennessee Highway Patrol said 34-year-old Roschey Brantley was wanted by Atlanta police in connection with a homicide investigation.

stories.title: Blount County Planning Commission debate continues after commissioner's resignation
stories.summary: Blount County’s debate over real estate professionals serving on the planning commission continued after Commissioner Nick Bright resigned Thursday.

stories.title: Nearly 10 years after Gatlinburg wildfires, Alamo Steakhouse continues family legacy
stories.summary: A decade after the 2016 wildfires destroyed Alamo Steakhouse in Gatlinburg, the Johnson family reflected on rebuilding and keeping its legacy alive.

stories.title: Firm quotes $850M to solve Knoxville's stormwater problem
stories.summary: Knoxville's stormwater systems face a critical $850 million repair, with a potential user fee proposed for residents, sparking debate over responsibility and cost.

stories.title: DA: No charges against KPD in man's in-custody August death
stories.summary: A Knox County District Attorney won't file charges against officers involved in Patrick Allen's in-custody death, citing no evidence warranting criminal prosecution.

stories.title: Great Smoky Mountains National Park to add 638-acre tract of land
stories.summary: The Foothills Land Conservancy purchased the property and is working to transfer it to the National Park Service.

stories.title: Byington-Solway Technical Center could become an AI academy by next year
stories.summary: Currently, the center teaches students trade skills.

stories.title: Knox County Schools shares details for 3 proposed Farragut rezoning scenarios
stories.summary: Knox County officials unveiled three proposed rezoning scenarios to address overcrowding in Farragut schools.

stories.title: DOJ: Kingston man employed at Y-12 National Security Site sentenced to 8 years for distributing child sexual abuse material on Kik
stories.summary: A judge sentenced Dustin Joyce, 38, to eight years on Tuesday for sharing CSA materials on Kik, officials said.
